Persist to disk/SQLite failed after a successful capture. The in-memory record is retained and the failure is surfaced.
Lookup by id, slug, title, or session ref missed on every source (disk, SQLite, local cache).
SVG screenshot content failed sanitization; the screenshot is rejected, the step is kept, the rejection is recorded.
CLI/UI parity check found an id-set delta. The delta is a filed bug against the surfacing layer, not a data problem.
An offline record failed to sync on reconnect. The local copy is kept and the failure is surfaced.
